name: Allstate
desc:
Licensed Personal Lines or P&C Insurance Agent (Remote/Home-Based) | $18/hr base ($52,730-$76,480/yr total comp) | Sales
Company: Allstate
Industry: Insurance
What Your Day Will Look Like:
 Picture yourself helping people who are already shopping for insurance find the right coverage, since Allstate sends you warm leads rather than having you cold call strangers. You'd engage with active insurance shoppers through inbound and outbound calls, live chat, and text, figuring out what they actually need, spotting gaps in their current coverage, and recommending the right Allstate product to fill that gap. This is genuine consultative sales work, meaning you're building trust and guiding someone to a decision, not just reading a script. You'll need to be comfortable navigating several computer systems at once while you're live on a call with a customer.

skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
Education Minimum: High School Diploma or GED required.
Required Experience: At least 1 year of sales or customer service experience with a sales focus.
Preferred Experience: An active Personal Lines or Property & Casualty Producer license in the participant's state of residence. Since WRO covers the cost of licensing, this is genuinely achievable for a participant without one already, Allstate also provides its own licensing support on top of that.
Required Skills:
Strong communication, critical thinking, and multitasking ability
Comfortable working evenings and weekends, especially during the first 90 days
Self-motivated and genuinely energized by performance-based rewards
Able to work independently and hold yourself accountable
Receptive to coaching and feedback
Ability to navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously while on a live call
Best Fit
 This role is ideal for:
Someone who wants real, uncapped earning potential and is motivated by performance-based incentives
Someone with at least a year of sales or customer service experience who's ready to grow into licensed insurance sales
A participant willing to complete P&C or Personal Lines licensing through WRO's licensing pathway, since Allstate itself also supports licensing costs and study materials
Someone comfortable with a schedule that includes evenings and weekends based on business needs
Not a Good Fit for:
Anyone who specifically wants to avoid sales work, since this is genuine consultative selling, not just customer support
Anyone who needs a fixed daytime-only schedule, since evening and weekend availability is a real requirement, particularly in the first 90 days
Anyone unwilling to give up outside insurance carrier appointments, since this role requires relinquishing any non-Allstate carrier appointments

Multi-channel customer engagement
Performance-driven sales results
Insurance product knowledge
Multi-system navigation
Goal and quota achievement

Licensing being obtained or has been obtained
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
 Application → Assessment → Phone screen → Final interview. Total time to hire averages 3 to 15 days.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell us about your sales or customer service experience and how you've been rewarded for performance in the past.
How do you feel about converting warm leads into customers through a consultative approach rather than cold calling?
Walk us through how you'd identify a gap in someone's current coverage and recommend a solution.
How do you stay motivated and self-accountable working independently from home?
What's your comfort level with an evening and weekend schedule, especially during your first 90 days?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: $18/hour base pay, with average total compensation of $52,730 to $76,480 per year once uncapped performance incentives are included. Licensed candidates who complete licensing before hire, or bring an active P&C or Personal Lines license before their start date, may be eligible for an additional bonus, worth flagging to WRO participants who complete licensing ahead of applying.
Shift: Full-time, with required evening and weekend availability based on business coverage needs, especially critical during the first 90 days of employment.
Benefits: Health, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match plus a pension plan, tuition reimbursement, career development, and wellness programs, all starting day one. Also includes paid training from day one, licensing support (study materials, exam reimbursement, and assistance), and a monthly internet reimbursement.
Equipment Provided: Provided. Allstate supplies a laptop, monitors, headset, keyboard, and mouse, plus a monthly connectivity reimbursement to help offset internet costs. Participant needs reliable internet with a wired Ethernet connection, minimum 50 Mbps download and 5 Mbps upload.
Felony Friendly?: Not stated. A background investigation is required for all candidates offered the position.
Drug Test: Not stated.
Notes: This is a genuinely strong opportunity for a participant coming through WRO's insurance licensing pathway, since Allstate covers the cost gap even further with its own licensing support on top of what WRO already provides. The uncapped incentive structure means real earning potential beyond the $18/hr base, but this is honest, real sales work with a required evening and weekend schedule, not a flexible or purely daytime role, so set that expectation clearly upfront. Worth noting Allstate excludes several states from this specific posting, though Oklahoma is not among them.
Career Pathway: Not stated directly in posting. Reasonable inferred path: Insurance Sales Representative → Senior Sales Representative → Sales Team Lead → Agency Manager, though this is an estimate, not confirmed by Allstate directly.
training: discussed in interview/ofer stage. must be available for any shift
